description: Persisted one-dimensional text arrays round-trip with catalog OIDs
sql: CREATE TABLE diff_array_types (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tags TEXT[]);
INSERT INTO diff_array_types (id, tags) VALUES ('a1', ARRAY['alpha', 'beta']::text[]);
SELECT id, tags FROM diff_array_types ORDER BY id;
SELECT a.attname, a.atttypid FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute a JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relname = 'diff_array_types' AND a.attname = 'tags';
